item.title: Ask HN: What did you learn when you stopped following tutorials?
item.summary: When I was working with Python, I noticed something interesting. If we build a Python project using a YouTube tutorial, it seems straightforward. But when I sit down with my laptop and code editor, I usually discover what I actually don’t understand. We will not learn logic by copying someone else’s code. I learned logic by figuring things out myself. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49330384 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
